what: Lantheus makes diagnostic imaging agents: injectable substances that make specific things visible on a scan. Its largest product, Pylarify, lights up prostate cancer on a PET scan, and Definity improves ultrasound images of the heart.
customers: Hospitals, imaging centres and radiopharmacies, and the urologists and cardiologists who order the scans. Reimbursement comes from Medicare and commercial insurers.
money: PSMA-targeted imaging agent for prostate cancer PET scans.
Ultrasound contrast agent for cardiac imaging.
Nuclear medicine generators and other diagnostic and therapeutic products.
moat: Radiopharmaceuticals decay, so they must be made close to the patient and delivered within hours. Lantheus has built a national network of radiopharmacies and manufacturing sites that is extremely difficult to replicate, and that logistics capability, not the molecule alone, is the real barrier.
risks: Pylarify's reimbursement has been the central uncertainty. Changes in how Medicare pays for the scan affect pricing and adoption directly, and the product dominates revenue.
Revenue has flattened at about $1.5B after two years of rapid growth, as competing PSMA imaging agents entered the market.
Competition in prostate imaging has intensified, with several approved alternatives now promoted aggressively.
The seven analysts average a $105.99 target, only about 4% above the current price.
Debt of $623.2M against $359.1M of cash reflects acquisitions made to broaden the pipeline.
opportunities: Free cash flow of roughly $393.1M against a $6.7B market value is substantial, and the shares trade at about 17 times free cash flow.
The radiopharmacy and manufacturing network can carry additional products, including therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals which are a fast-growing field.
Prostate cancer PET imaging is still under-penetrated relative to clinical guidelines, so volume can grow even as price competition bites.
Acquisitions have added pipeline assets in Alzheimer's imaging and radiotherapeutics, broadening the business beyond its two main products.
watch: Pylarify volume against price. The product is facing competitors and reimbursement pressure simultaneously, so growing scan volumes have to outrun falling price per scan for the company to grow at all.
